svg.title: From ChatGPT discovery to merchant checkout: an ACP product feed, a ChatGPT plugin, then external checkout or the payment sheet beta
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: From ChatGPT discovery to merchant checkout: an ACP product feed, a ChatGPT plugin, then external checkout or the payment sheet beta. 5 participants: Shopper, ChatGPT (agent surface), Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget), Merchant (site, catalog and vault), and Merchant PSP and card rails. 13 steps, 10 crossing a trust boundary, 7 failure branches. Based on several protocols ACP 2026-04-17 OpenAI plugin checkout reference, formerly the Apps SDK monetization guide (read 2026-10-20) (2026-04-17). Step 1: Merchant (site, catalog and vault) to ChatGPT (agent surface): Push the product feed (ACP Feed API). This step crosses a trust boundary. If A feed file replaces the whole set with a partial file: Products missing from the file drop out the ACP file mode replaces the full product set. Step 2: Shopper to ChatGPT (agent surface): Ask for a product. Step 3: ChatGPT (agent surface) to Shopper: Show matching products from feeds. Step 4: ChatGPT (agent surface) to Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget): Open the merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP tool call). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 5: Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget) to Shopper: Path A (generally available): link to the merchant's own checkout. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 6: Shopper to Merchant (site, catalog and vault): Path A: pay on the merchant's site. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 7: Merchant (site, catalog and vault) to Merchant PSP and card rails: Path A: authorize through the merchant's PSP. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The issuer declines: An ordinary decline on the merchant's site. Step 8: Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget) to ChatGPT (agent surface): Path B (private beta): widget calls window.openai.requestCheckout. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 9: Shopper to ChatGPT (agent surface): Path B: choose a payment method and buy. If The shopper closes the sheet: No token is sent and nothing is charged. Step 10: ChatGPT (agent surface) to Merchant (site, catalog and vault): Path B, PCI DSS Level 1 merchants only: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment. This step crosses a trust boundary. If Card data fails validation: Delegate Payment error invalid_card. If The same Idempotency-Key with a different body: idempotency_conflict. Step 11: Merchant (site, catalog and vault) to ChatGPT (agent surface): Path B, PCI DSS Level 1: 201 with a vault token id. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 12: ChatGPT (agent surface) to Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget): Path B: complete_checkout tool call with a payment-method token. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 13: Merchant's ChatGPT plugin (MCP server and widget) to Merchant PSP and card rails: Path B: charge the token through a supported PSP. This step crosses a trust boundary. If A delegated token is used outside its allowance: Should fail, but ACP defines no error code for it the error is PSP specific. If The issuer declines: An ordinary decline the app tells the shopper.
